## 4.2.6 (HexGhoul): the General, Ayato and Noro: much more to talk about, and ways to get on their bad side

HexKagune 4.2.6 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (129).

You said (quoted exactly): "I expect a little more dialogue on every single one of them. Um, So develop every single NPC even further, add
more dialogue, more options, all of them."

**The General** has 13 new topics (21 in all): what he's working on, the three partners he outlived (told once), Arima, advice for a rookie,
running the tower, the ghoul he once let go (told once), who taught him to fight with his legs, retiring, his glasses, and for a ghoul who
isn't with him yet, what it would take for him to trust one. Once you're together: dancing, when he fell for you, and promises.

**Ayato** has 12 new topics (21 in all): the Black Rabbit, training together, Anteiku and his sister, his weakness, the scar he got protecting
Touka at fourteen (told once), the CCG, his night patrols, Eto, what Touka was like as a kid. Once you're together: when he started liking
you, promises, and a pet name (you get to say "Bunny" exactly once).

**Noro** has 8 new topics (11 in all), still in his way: a word or two, or what he does. Whether he ever talks, Eto, his students, his coat
(don't touch it), being a kakuja, sleep, his real name (told once), and what he's afraid of.

Every new topic has answers that win them and answers that cost you: tell the General his partners can be replaced, tell Ayato not all doves
are bad or call him shorty, tell Noro that Eto is using him, and they'll hold it against you. Kind answers count once a day each; unkind ones
always count. The stories told once and the promises are one-time, as with Banjou and Roma.
